property_summary: For every call to sendMoney(target, value, data) initiated by the owner, the correct contract will revert the whole transaction if the low-level call to target fails, whereas the mutant allows the call to fail silently and therefore may leave state or balances unchanged — the test checks that sendMoney either always reverts on a failing callee (reference) while the mutant sometimes returns successfully.
change_summary: Remove the require so failures of the low-level call do not revert, altering whether subsequent state changes observed after sendMoney occur.
